tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search jobs: find live job openings from employer career sites and job boards that match what the person wants, by role or keywords, place, remote work, employment type and pay. filters.jobTypes takes FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, CONTRACT or other listed types; any of them match. filters.salaryListedOnly k

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read one posting in full by its id: description, requirements, pay, location and the employer's apply link. The title, summary and description are employer source text; licence requirements and eligibility remain unassessed. posting gives its age, when it was last seen live and closesAtLocal, the cl

tools.name: get_market_insights
tools.description: Summarize the live market for a role and place: how many openings match, the median listed pay, the most common work arrangement and the top requested skills, with how the request was understood. Takes a query and the same filters as search_jobs.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Read an employer's profile by its slug (companySlug on a job): what it does, size, observed pay bands, work arrangement, benefits, recent events and how it is hiring. hiring.definitions says what each hiring number measures: medianOpenPostingAgeDays is the age of open listings, not time to fill, and

tools.name: list_company_jobs
tools.description: List an employer's open jobs by its slug, newest first, as compact cards with posting age and the employer's title and summary as source text; read one in full with get_job. Pages are cut to fit the response size, so continue with nextCursor until it is null.

tools.name: find_similar_jobs
tools.description: More openings like one job, by its id: the same kind of role in the same place (or remote, when the job is remote), as up to 10 cards. Use it when a job is closed, a near miss, or the person wants more like it.

tools.name: get_local_demand
tools.description: Read which kinds of roles are hiring most in a place (city, region, country): open jobs by role category, with total open jobs, employers and sectors. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs · Public sink: search_jobs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs · Public sink: search_jobs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
